note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). All four screens are portal screens in the lab tenant (DEV).
prepare: # owner signs in: browser profiles for labadmin (make.powerautomate.com, SharePoint) and jordan.demo (Outlook on the web, member of finance-approvers). Nothing is typed or stored here.

# owner (tenant, demo.md Setup 1): turn the episode 2 approval flow OFF, then create last week's items in Purchase Requests: [CC-4100] Laptops for two new developers 12,500 Approved; [CC-4100] USB-C docking stations 1,800 Approved; [cc-2200] Ergonomic chairs for the support team 4,350.50 Approved; Conference tickets 950 Approved; [CC-3300] Monitor arms 120 Approved; [CC-2200] Standing desks 2,400 Rejected; [CC-4100] Mechanical keyboard 89.90 Pending (created by alex.demo, jordan.demo and taylor.demo)

# owner (demo.md Setup 2-4): solution Purchasing Reports (PurchasingReports) with the flow 'Weekly purchasing digest'; run it once with Test > Manually so the run and the e-mail to finance-approvers exist

screens.name: list
steps: Open the list 'Purchase Requests' and filter it to last week
Show the Status column (Approved, Rejected, Pending)
Point at the titles with a cost-centre prefix, the lower-case '[cc-2200]' one and 'Conference tickets' without a prefix
mask: tenant name in the address bar and the SharePoint header
any e-mail address that is not a lab user

screens.name: select-designer
steps: Select environment DEV, open Solutions > Purchasing Reports
Open the flow 'Weekly purchasing digest' in the new designer
Expand the 'Rows' (Select) action: map in key/value mode with reference, costCentre, item, requester, amount, submitted
Click into the costCentre value to open the expression editor and show the if(and(startsWith(...)), toUpper(slice(...)), 'Unassigned') expression
mask: environment ID in the address bar
tenant name in the top bar
site URL inside the Get items card

screens.name: run-total
steps: Open the run history of 'Weekly purchasing digest' and the manual test run
Show every action green and no 'Apply to each' anywhere
Expand 'Total' (Compose) and show the output (the lab week's total)
Expand 'By cost centre' (Select) and show the array with costCentre, requests and total per cost centre
mask: environment ID in the address bar
e-mail addresses in the run outputs that are not lab users

screens.name: digest-email
steps: In the browser profile of Jordan Demo open the finance-approvers group mailbox (or the inbox where the digest lands)
Open the mail 'Approved purchases, week of <date>: <total> EUR'
Show the first line with the count and the Monday-to-Sunday dates
Scroll to the 'By cost centre' table and the 'Top three' table with reference, item, requester, amount and Lisbon time
mask: real tenant domain and e-mail addresses
tenant name in the suite bar

teardown: # owner (tenant): turn the digest flow off; turn the episode 2 approval flow back on if it is still needed; delete last week's sample requests if the list is not reused
